entities.title: ZAZZLE_SOCK
entities.summary: The daemon's socket path.
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle daemon serve` (unless --socket is given or launchd passed a socket), by `zazzle daemon mcp` to reach the daemon, and by `zazzle daemon install`, which writes it into the LaunchAgent. The C invoker reads it too (src/macos/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h build_path).
entities.details: A daemon installed as a LaunchAgent keeps the socket path that was current when `zazzle daemon install` ran.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_SESSION
entities.summary: The session key for ids, dedupe and rerunning a response with read-again on the command line.
entities.default: unset (no session: no session ids, no dedupe and no rerun by read-again; stored clean, run and proxy outputs still carry their own ids and can be read again)
entities.scope: Read by the C invoker, which sends it in the request (src/macos/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h build_request), and by `zazzle daemon run`. The daemon itself does not read it; `zazzle daemon mcp` uses a random session per process instead.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_IDLE_SECS
entities.summary: How long `zazzle daemon serve` waits with no connection before it exits.
entities.scope: `zazzle daemon serve`, including a daemon the invoker or the MCP front end starts, which inherits their environment. `--idle SECS` overrides it.
entities.validation: A value that is not a whole number is ignored and the default used.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CACHE_DIR
entities.summary: Where the persistent cache lives.
entities.scope: `zazzle daemon serve`. `zazzle daemon run` uses no persistent cache.
entities.validation: If the directory cannot be created or opened, the daemon prints `daemon: cache disabled: ...` and runs with the in-memory cache only. A new directory is made mode 0700, marked for Spotlight not to index, and on macOS excluded from Time Machine.

entities.title: HOME
entities.summary: The base of the default socket path, cache directory, output store and indexer state directory.
entities.scope: Every daemon subcommand that needs a default path, `zazzle daemon install` for ~/Library/LaunchAgents, and the C# indexer bridge.
entities.validation: Unset: `HOME is not set` where a default path is needed; the cache is then disabled, outputs are not stored (unless ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR is set) and carry no output id, and C# files are read as source.

entities.title: zazzle daemon serve --socket, --idle
entities.summary: Command-line options of `zazzle daemon serve`: an explicit socket path, and the idle time in seconds.
entities.scope: One `zazzle daemon serve` process. The tests and the invoker's smoke test and benchmarks start the daemon with --socket.
entities.validation: A missing value, a non-numeric --idle or an unknown option is a usage error, exit 2.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_INDEXER
entities.summary: The csharp-indexer executable the daemon uses for the terse C# view and the structure tools.
entities.default: csharp-indexer beside the daemon executable, else the first on PATH
entities.scope: Read in the process that renders a C# read (the daemon, or `zazzle daemon run`), on each such read.
entities.validation: An empty value counts as unset. If no executable is found, C# files are read as source with `(no terse view: csharp-indexer is not installed (beside the daemon or on PATH); this is the source)`. Its version is asked once per executable and process.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR
entities.summary: The indexer's state directory, which holds its daemon socket; the daemon looks for `daemon.sock` there.
entities.key: ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR (falling back to XDG_STATE_HOME on Linux)
entities.scope: The C# indexer bridge, on each C# read and each structure command. It mirrors how the indexer itself chooses the directory, so both must see the same environment; a zazzle daemon starts inherits daemon's.

relationships.description: The indexer owns the state directory's layout.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR
entities.summary: Where clean, run and proxy outputs are stored for read-again.
entities.scope: Read by each process that stores or loads outputs: `zazzle daemon serve` and `zazzle daemon run` when they open their engine (clean stores, read-again loads), `zazzle daemon wrap` on each run, and `zazzle daemon proxy` at its start. A `zazzle run` or proxy output can be read again only by a daemon that uses the same directory.
entities.validation: An empty value counts as unset. Without it and without HOME nothing is stored. The directory is created mode 0700 and each file 0600; a save that fails leaves the output in the answer with a note that it was not stored.
entities.details: A running daemon keeps the directory it started with; `zazzle daemon wrap` reads the variable from the caller's environment on every run.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_MAX_GB
entities.summary: The output store's size limit in gigabytes.
entities.scope: Read by the process that stores an output, on each save: the daemon for clean, `zazzle daemon wrap` for run, `zazzle daemon proxy` for shortened texts.
entities.validation: A value that is not a number, or not above 0, is ignored and the default used. After a save, if the entries younger than an hour hold more bytes than the limit, the oldest go until half remain.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATOR
entities.summary: The agent that does zazzle's own housekeeping instead of the local model: `[local:|claude:|codex:]MODEL[@EFFORT]`.
entities.scope: Read by `investigate --adaptive` (unless a flag names the orchestrator), `zazzle brief` and `--llm` post-processing.
entities.validation: Parsed as an agent spec; an unknown kind or effort fails the commands that use an orchestrator, no others. A flag wins.
entities.details: A hosted agent (`claude`, `codex`) receives what zazzle sends it: for `--llm` and `zazzle brief` that is the command output and the skill menu.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATOR_EFFORT
entities.summary: The orchestrator's effort, which wins over `@EFFORT` in ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATOR.
entities.default: the agent's default (low for a local model, medium for claude and codex)
entities.scope: Read by `investigate --adaptive` (unless a flag names the orchestrator), `zazzle brief` and `--llm` post-processing.
entities.validation: Must be an effort the agent takes; without ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATOR it is refused where an orchestrator is used.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_ORCHESTRATION_LOG
entities.summary: Where the text-free record of each `investigate --adaptive` run is appended.
entities.scope: Read by each adaptive run.
entities.validation: An empty value disables the log. If its folder or file cannot be created or written, the record is dropped without failing the command.
entities.details: Records hold counts, hashes, agents, efforts, tokens and seconds; no question, path, claim or response text.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_USAGE_LOG
entities.summary: Where privacy-preserving final response delivery metrics are appended.
entities.scope: Read when a daemon engine starts, including the daemon and `zazzle daemon run`.
entities.validation: An empty value disables the log. If its parent or file cannot be created, delivery logging is disabled without failing the command.
entities.details: Records contain sizes, estimated tokens, a short response hash, the command, status, session and whether dedupe changed the result; they contain no arguments or response text.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_MCP_ZAZZ
entities.summary: Whether `zazzle daemon mcp` lists the zazzle_zazz_* tools.
entities.default: unset: listed only when the zazz store ($ZAZZ_STORE or ~/.zazzle/v1/zazz) has a registered script
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle daemon mcp` for each tools/list.
entities.details: `1` always lists them, any other value never does; hiding them saves about 5,000 characters of tool catalog per session.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LANGUAGES_DIR
entities.summary: Where language modules and the JIT setting are kept.
entities.scope: Read by daemon when it loads, lists or fetches language modules.
entities.details: The `jit` file in it holds `on` or `off` (`zazzle languages jit`).

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LANGUAGES_URL
entities.summary: Where language modules download from.
entities.scope: Read by daemon when it downloads a module.
entities.details: Downloads are still checked against the manifest compiled into daemon, so another source can only serve the same files.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LANGUAGES_MANIFEST (build time)
entities.summary: The language module manifest compiled into daemon.
entities.default: unset: an empty manifest (development builds have no grammars)
entities.scope: Read by daemon's build script.
entities.details: The release sets it to the manifest language-modules.sh --manifest wrote after building and signing the modules.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_TOOLS_DIR
entities.summary: Where downloaded JIT tools (ai-agent) are kept.
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle daemon llm` when it looks for or downloads ai-agent.
entities.details: A tool beside the daemon executable is used first, without looking here.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_TOOLS_URL
entities.summary: Where JIT tools download from.
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle daemon llm` when it downloads a tool.
entities.details: Downloads are still checked against the tool manifest compiled into daemon, so another source can only serve the same files.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_TOOLS_MANIFEST (build time)
entities.summary: The JIT tool manifest compiled into daemon.
entities.default: unset: an empty manifest (development builds download no tool; put ai-agent beside the daemon instead)
entities.scope: Read by daemon's build script.
entities.details: The release sets it to the manifest tools.sh --manifest wrote after building and signing the tools.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LLM
entities.summary: The ai-agent program the daemon runs for --llm, brief and prompt.
entities.default: ai-agent beside the daemon, else from the tool store (downloading the program, never a model)
entities.scope: Read by the daemon (and `zazzle run`) each time it asks the local model.
entities.details: Not used by `zazzle daemon llm`, which execs ai-agent through the tools module.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CODEX
entities.summary: The `codex` program the adaptive mode runs for its `codex:` rungs, reviews and benchmarks.
entities.scope: Read by the daemon each time the adaptive mode asks a hosted agent.
entities.details: Only used when --agents, --review-model or --benchmark-model names a hosted agent; it runs read-only in the working directory.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CLAUDE
entities.summary: The `claude` program the adaptive mode runs for its `claude:` rungs, reviews and benchmarks.
entities.scope: Read by the daemon each time the adaptive mode asks a hosted agent.
entities.details: Only used when --agents, --review-model or --benchmark-model names a hosted agent; it runs read-only in the working directory.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LLM_TIMEOUT
entities.summary: How many seconds one local model call (chat, prompt, --llm, brief, investigate) may take before the worker is killed.
entities.scope: Read by the daemon (and `zazzle run`) each time it asks the local model.
entities.validation: A positive whole number; anything else means the default.

entities.title: --llm INSTRUCTION
entities.summary: A global option of every daemon command and of `zazzle run`: hand the output to the local model with this instruction and print its answer.
entities.scope: One command line; over MCP, the `llm` argument of a tool that only reads.
entities.validation: Must not be blank: `--llm needs an instruction for the local model`.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LLM_IDLE
entities.summary: How many seconds the daemon keeps the local model's worker loaded after its last call.
entities.scope: Read by the daemon's reaper thread each time it checks.
entities.validation: A positive whole number; anything else means the default.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CHAT_DIR
entities.summary: The folder the daemon keeps each terminal's chat in.
entities.scope: Read by the daemon for each llm-chat operation.
entities.validation: Any path; it is created when a chat is saved.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CHAT_SESSION
entities.summary: Names the chat `zazzle agent chat` and `zazzle agent prompt` use, instead of the terminal device and the shell's session id.
entities.default: the terminal device and session id
entities.scope: Read by the chat client when it starts.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_GH
entities.summary: The gh program zazzle flow deliver and ci run.
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle flow` each run.
entities.details: Used to find, open and update pull requests and read their checks.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CI_POLL_SECS
entities.summary: Seconds between looks at a pull request's checks while zazzle flow ci waits.
entities.scope: Read by `zazzle flow` each run.
entities.details: zazzle waits inside one call and reports once; the caller does not poll.
